example_dialogues.text_b: I am upset because I have to calibrate the torque wrench again. I always reset it after use but this morning I forgot and it was such a silly mistake.
I am angry because I have to clean the gearbox housing again. I always drain the oil fully but this morning I forgot and the instructor marked me down.
I am tired because I have to carry all the metal plates again. I always use the trolley but today I forgot and my feet already hurt after walking for so long.

dialogues.text_b: I am angry because I have to align the shafts again. I always check the dial indicator properly but today I forgot and the instructor marked me down.
I am tired because I have to polish the machine parts again. I always wear hand protection but today I forgot and my hands already hurt.
I am upset because I have to recheck the hydraulic lines again. I always tighten the fittings correctly but today I forgot and it was such a silly mistake.
I am angry because I have to refit the bearings again. I always heat them slightly before installing but today I forgot and the instructor marked me down.
I am upset because I have to adjust the belt tension again. I always measure the slack properly but today I forgot and it was such a silly mistake.
I am tired because I have to deburr all the edges again. I always get mixed duties, but today I got only this and my feet already hurt after standing for so long.

activity_b.text: Good morning, Azhar. Nice to meet you.
Please relax and take a seat.
How are you feeling today?
Good morning, sir. How are you today?
Quite good. I’m looking forward to talking to you about my career.
Let’s start with something simple then.
Tell me, what do you know about our company?
Last night I read about your company on the Internet.
I saw that you recently serviced a large machining line in Kurunegala and that you focus strongly on precision and safety.
I also liked the way you use modern diagnostic tools.
I’m glad you checked it.
Now, before we talk about your skills, tell me—what do you like most in the mechanical field?
Honestly, sir, I like solving problems with machines.
When we adjust a belt, align a shaft, or calibrate a gauge, I can see the results immediately.
I also enjoy working with a team.
That’s a good attitude.
And what tasks are you good at?
I am good at assembling small mechanical units and checking machine components.
During my training, I replaced bearings, cleaned housings, and helped the instructor align pulleys.
And what technical skills do you have?
I know how to read simple mechanical drawings, measure dimensions, and use tools like vernier calipers, torque wrenches, and feeler gauges.
Last month, I adjusted an imbalanced rotating part at the workshop.
We sometimes use digital vibration analysers.
Are you familiar with them?
I am not familiar with them, sir, but I can read about them on the Internet.
That’s how I learned more about predictive maintenance.
Excellent.
Finally, why should we select you?
Because I learn fast, I work diligently, and I’m always ready to support the team.
Well said, Azhar. We’ll contact you soon.
